text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That was so cool, Yaeno! So that's the
Kongo
Yaegaki style!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe this historic style of
martial arts can
be applied to racing, so I
commit myself to it
daily.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That training must be what gives you
such great
core strength! Maybe I should
try it too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your father was a sumo wrestler, was he
not? Did
you ever train with him?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As a child, yes. I learned how to stomp,
use a
teppo pole, slide my feet without
raising them,
and do a side split.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think those are very valuable
experiences,
especially since you've
seen the proper
techniques for them
many times.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I recommend you try incorporating those

techniques into your training before
trying new
ones. You'll be able to train
more effectively with
techniques you
intimately understand.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Techniques I understand... True, I have watched my dad train hundreds of times before! I practically have those moves memorized!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try it out right away! I bet
I'll be able
to understand important
points about them that I
didn't realize as
a child!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O starts incorporating
sumo
training into her schedule and, in
doing so,
manages to pick up a few
tricks!
